name: KEMER1
description: RWY 05: on departure turn left hdg 360 to intercept DAN R-360 outbound to 10DME, climb to 4000. When reaching 10DME turn left hdg 310 direct KEMER. Climb to FL220. From over KEMER turn left hdg 255 direct ERGEP. RWY 23: on departure climb on DAN R-229 to 4000. When reaching 10DME turn right hdg 325 direct KEMER. Climb to FL220. From over KEMER turn left hdg 255 direct ERGEP.
route: DCT KEMER DCT ERGEP/D1+00 ERGEP DCT KEMER DCT DAN LTAG
remarks: Formations expect block FL210-FL230. RECOVERY: contact Ankara Center (CH7). When cleared on the recovery, depart the MOA and descend to cross ERGEP at FL180 or as assigned. After ERGEP proceed direct KEMER, after KEMER proceed direct Incirlik TACAN. Expect further clearance from Incirlik Radar. Nonstandard formation is automatically authorized in the block FL160 to FL180 within 3nm of lead aircraft.
